jobs.description:
Join our Sitaware Extensions Program and help deliver customised integrations and extensions to Systematic's defence product suite, from sensor interfaces to radio drivers. As Senior Software Developer, you will combine software design, implementation and testing in a close-knit team working in an exciting domain.

The job

You will contribute to the delivery of high-quality integrations and extensions, from requirements analysis through software design, implementation and testing. Beyond hands-on development, you will help apply and improve our development process, and share your knowledge to support the team's growth.

In short, you can look forward to:

• Designing, implementing, documenting and debugging features, working primarily on back-end development (Java) and occasionally on front-end development (Angular)

• Analysing requirements, breaking them into technical tasks, and clarifying acceptance criteria

• Implementing and troubleshooting interfaces to hardware and external systems, such as sensors and radio interfaces

• Developing and maintaining unit and integration tests, and designing for testability

• Identifying issues and recommending improvements to code, tooling, pipelines and processes

Joining the team

You will be part of the Product Extension Team of around seven developers, test engineers and architects, part of the Sitaware Extensions Program within Defence Services. The team delivers customised integrations and extensions to Systematic's defence product suite, focusing on software- and hardware-related integrations such as sensor interfaces, radio drivers and interoperability with external systems, and continuously improves its own testing and development practices, methods and tools. This is a newly created position, so you will have real scope to shape how the role develops as the team continues to grow.

Your qualifications

To succeed in this role, you bring several years of software development experience gained in a structured, team-based environment, along with:

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Software Technology or similar

• Hands-on experience with Java (or a related object-oriented technology) for backend development, and Angular (or a similar modern framework) for frontend development

• Fluent English; Danish is a nice-to-have

Alongside this, we value:

• Strong analytical abilities, with a focused and open mindset

• The ability to communicate intent and purpose clearly, both in writing and conversation

• Enjoys collaborating closely within a cross-functional team

Onboarding includes two three-day stays in Aarhus, and you should expect occasional travel of around two to ten days a year, mostly within Europe. Some onsite hardware testing may also be required, depending on integration needs.

Please note that you must be able to present a clean criminal record and have lived in a NATO and/or an EU country for the past seven years as we work with security-classified projects. Read more here.

Welcome to Systematic Copenhagen

When you join us in Copenhagen, you're not just getting a desk at one of the city's best locations—you are stepping into a workplace where community matters. Our Employees Club keeps things lively with monthly social events, and our office catering makes sure you are always well taken care of. Whether you are into casual games or just good company, you will find both at our foosball table or during our relaxed Friday bar gatherings.

Never stop developing

Systematic is uniquely people-centric, truly international and proudly rooted in Denmark with more than 1100 employees. Together, we write intelligent and innovative code to drive progress and improve lives. We develop IT solutions that make a real difference where it matters most. This is why we never stop developing. Here, there is room to be professional and personal. It is not just a place to work but a place to belong.

Start your development here

We will be assessing applications on an ongoing basis as we wish to welcome our new colleague as soon as possible, so click Apply Now and send us your CV today. If you have any questions, you are always welcome to contact us on tel. +45 8943 2000 and ask for Andreas Markussen, Senior Manager.

People & Organization

**Bring structure, service and ownership to every step of the employee journey

**Are you a detail-oriented P&O professional who enjoys working with people, processes and systems? Join Xellia’s Copenhagen P&O team for a one-year interim assignment and help deliver high-quality support across the entire employee lifecycle – from hire to retire.

Working close to the business

You will join a small, collaborative P&O & Payroll team in Copenhagen, supporting our Danish and Norwegian organisations and working with international colleagues. With four colleagues in the local team and approximately 18 across global P&O, you will have varied responsibilities, direct contact with employees and managers, and the opportunity to contribute to improvements in how we work.

Your role – make things happen

You will provide reliable day-to-day P&O administration and practical support across the hire-to-retire process, including:

• Prepare employment contracts, addendums and other documentation; keep employee and payroll-related data accurate and up to date.

• Support recruitment activities, including interviews, assessments and candidate feedback, and help organise onboarding and introduction days.

• Manage employee changes and offboarding in P&O, payroll, time and leave systems; respond to questions from employees and managers.

• Support annual P&O processes, including bonus and salary review cycles and administration linked to collective agreements.

• Maintain P&O policies, templates, digital personnel records and approval workflows, supporting compliance and audit readiness.

• Prepare P&O and payroll-related data for internal and external stakeholders and share relevant updates with leaders.

• Contribute to ad hoc P&O projects, including opportunities to simplify and automate processes using digital tools and AI.

What you bring

• A strong administrative background, ideally with experience in P&O or a similar people-support function.

• Strong working knowledge of P&O administration, employee documentation and digital HR/payroll systems, with the ability to use tools accurately and consistently.

• Ability to coordinate multiple hire-to-retire processes, maintain reliable data and deliver timely, high-quality outcomes.

• A service-minded approach to supporting managers and employees, with care, accuracy and follow-through.

• Clear communication skills in Danish and English, both written and spoken.

You take accountability for your commitments and adapt readily when priorities change. You combine practical functional knowledge with confidence in P&O systems and tools, and you work well with colleagues and stakeholders from different cultures and backgrounds. You listen to the needs of managers and employees and take pride in providing reliable support.

A word from our team

“Great P&O support is about more than processes and administration. It’s about understanding people’s needs, taking ownership and making everyday work easier for our colleagues. We are looking for someone who enjoys bringing structure, quality and a service-minded approach to everything they do — and who wants to be part of a team where we support each other and make a real difference.”

Kira Mondrup, Director, Global Employee Relations and P&O Copenhagen

What’s in it for you?

• Xellia isn’t for all: There’s no rigid hierarchy here, and no one will micromanage you. You’re trusted — and expected — to take real responsibility, perform at a high level, and learn fast. In return, you get the opportunity to shape how things are done, influence decisions, and make a visible impact.

• Make things happen: You’ll step into an organization in motion, with clear direction and ambitious goals. Here, you can grow fast, take on more than a fixed role, and shape what’s next alongside people who want to win.

Are you interested?

We would like our new colleague to join as soon as possible.

We are your people

Everything we do connects to our purpose to save lives. Every day, every task we do plays a part in one of the biggest battles of our time: fighting the most powerful bacteria on the planet. But at Xellia, it's not just about what we do - it's about how we do it and who we do it with. We work side by side, eye to eye, and heart to heart across functions and sites, building strong relationships and making an impact. We run on curiosity, trust, and honest conversations. We speak up and share what we know. It's not just where you want to go. It's who you get there with. At Xellia, we're your people.

Xellia is owned by Novo Holdings A/S, headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, and operates four sites globally.

Xellia Pharmaceuticals is the global leader in fermentation-based, non-beta-lactam anti-infectives, supplying Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs) and Finished Dosage Forms (FDFs) to over 500 pharmaceutical companies across 80 countries.

Recognized by the World Health Organization and the European Union for our critical medicines, we play a vital role in combating severe infections and antimicrobial resistance. Headquartered in Denmark, we operate manufacturing sites in Copenhagen, Denmark; Budapest, Hungary; and Taizhou, China, with R&D and commercial operations in seven additional locations globally. As the only European manufacturer of several key anti-infectives and with a heritage spanning over 120 years, we are driven by purpose and progress.

With more than 1100 employees, our impact starts from within. We offer a workplace where ideas, curiosity, and initiative thrive, and where your role evolves with your ambition. Instead of rigid structures, we provide real responsibility, freedom to explore, and support to grow. Together, we shape not only the future of our company and the development of our people, but also the health of communities worldwide.

Further information aboutXellia can be found at: www.xellia.com

Connect with us on LinkedIn

**💰 🇩🇰 up to 46,000 DKK gross/month (depending on seniority level)

**Intro

Monta powers the EV charging ecosystem. With 300,000+ monthly users and millions of charge sessions every month, our platform accelerates the electrification of mobility.

This is a fast-moving place. The problems are hard, the pace is quick, and the bar is high. If you like real ownership, figuring things out, and seeing the direct impact of your work, you’ll do well with us.

AI is built into how we work. It helps us ship faster, make better decisions, and stay lean. Everyone at Monta is expected to use AI tools thoughtfully - and to find smart ways to use them to move the work forward.

Our principles keep us grounded: Build Together & Finish, Sweat the Details, Customer First, and Aim for the Moon.

The best part of Monta is the people - sharp, ambitious, and good to be around. You’ll be challenged, supported, and trusted to deliver.

We’re looking for a Jun/Mid Level Engineer who’s ready to roll up their sleeves, take ownership, and build with us - through the grind and the wins.

This Is What You Will Achieve

• Owned an OCPP hardening project - chased down a recurring class of vendor quirks (malformed messages, connection drops, the long tail of hardware oddities), shipped the fix, and measurably cut failed sessions or disconnections for that device family.

• Helped shift the team from reacting to incidents to preventing them, through alerting and observability work that catches problems earlier.

• Made real progress on OCPP 1.6, OCPP 2.0.1, and OCPI standards work that other services and front-ends across Monta now rely on.

What You Will Do

• Build and maintain backend services in NetOps' OCPP and charge point domain - protocol handling, message processing, device state, integrations with hardware vendors.

• Debug things that only break in the field. A charge point in Belgium disconnects every 40 minutes - you'll read the OCPP traffic, reproduce it against our emulator, find the cause, and fix it.

• Improve observability and alerting. Add the metrics, dashboards, and alerts that mean the next person doesn't have to guess.

• Take part in on-call once you're ramped up, with a team that treats a rough night as a reason to fix the system, not a rite of passage.

• Automate manual work away - a meaningful part of NetOps' job is removing the human steps that don't scale as our network grows.

• Collaborate across Product, Support, and the operations teams who live with the consequences of what we ship. You won't work in a silo.

**A Brief Overview Of Our Tech Stack

**

• Kotlin services (JVM), with Java where it already lives

• PHP/Laravel monolith - parts of our charge point domain still run here

• OCPP 1.6 / 2.0.1 and OCPI protocol handling

• Event-driven work with Kafka where message volume calls for it

• Observability via Prometheus, Grafana, and OpenSearch/Kibana

• AWS + Kubernetes, with Terraform for infrastructure

What We’re Looking For

• 1–4 years of backend engineering experience, or a strong junior track record with real production exposure. You write clean, readable code and finish what you start.

• Comfortable in a JVM language - Kotlin preferred, Java fine, and we'll help you get there from another stack if the fundamentals are strong. Willingness to touch PHP in our legacy monolith when the work calls for it.

• You enjoy debugging, genuinely - logs, traces, packet-level detail, weird one-off reports from a single customer.

• A sense of ownership - you follow your work into production, watch it, and flag problems early rather than waiting to be asked.

• Nice to have: curiosity about the physical world (our systems talk to metal boxes with electricity in them); clear communication - you can explain what broke and why to someone who isn't an engineer; advanced, deliberate use of AI tools in your daily engineering workflow.

• Bonus points for: exposure to OCPP, OCPI, EV charging, or the EV industry as a driver or enthusiast; IoT, embedded, or telemetry systems where devices in the field misbehave; event-driven architectures (Kafka) or high-volume message processing; reliability/monitoring/on-call experience (Prometheus, Grafana, SLOs); Kubernetes, Terraform, or infrastructure-as-code exposure.

**If the mission excites you but your experience isn’t a perfect 1:1 match, apply anyway - we care about potential, not perfection.

**AI Competency

• You’ll be expected to work with AI-powered tools. Some we use:

• GitHub Copilot / Claude Code

• ChatGPT / Gemini / Claude

• Notion AI (docs, knowledge, meeting notes)

• Analytics & ML: Langfuse, PyTorch, Mastra

• AI-enhanced testing & monitoring (e.g., generative QA, Grafana ML)

• We don’t expect mastery of all - but we expect comfort learning, experimenting, and adopting AI responsibly.

Why Monta

• Impact, not easy mode - your work matters, and you’ll feel it every day.

• Ownership from day one - we don’t micromanage, we expect you to deliver.

• The grind is real - priorities shift, and flexibility is sometimes needed to get things across the finish line. But so are the rewards: impact, growth, and a team that has your back.

• The people are extraordinary - talented, driven, and fun to work with. You’ll be challenged, supported, and inspired in equal measure.

What We Offer

• A yearly education budget and extra days off to use it.

• A friendly and social company culture with movie nights, Friday bars, pub crawls, and more.

• Free lunch every day.

• Pension & health coverage to keep you secure for today and tomorrow.

• Paid parental leave to support life's big moments.

• Warrants program - be part of our growth story.

• Flexible working hours; as long as you're at key meetings and delivering great work, we trust you to manage your schedule.

Please send us your application in English.

To succeed in this position, your spoken and written English skills need to be proficient. Since Monta is a globally active company, you'll be communicating often and regularly with our co-workers and partners around the world, making your professional English knowledge essential.

Please note that we don't accept unsolicited applications from headhunters or recruitment agencies. Unsolicited applications sent to our company or co-workers are considered to be the property of Monta, and we won't agree to pay any referral compensation or recruiter fee without a signed agreement.

Find out more by visiting https://monta.com/uk/careers/

Monta is building the platform that powers the future of EV charging. We connect hardware, software, businesses, and drivers into one seamless ecosystem. Our mission is to make charging simple, reliable, and scalable for everyone.

_Do you want to join a global leader in renewable energy infrastructure? If so, CIP Fund Solutions (CIP FS) is looking for a Global Mobility Manager to join our office in Copenhagen, Denmark.

_**Team

**You will join a global People team of more than 15 colleagues with diverse responsibilities and mandates. You will be part of the HR Legal & Mobility team, which comprises six colleagues.

**Role

**As Global Mobility Manager, you will manage global mobility cases and key operational workstreams across global tax, social security, immigration and relocation.

You will advise internal stakeholders on mobility processes, coordinate complex cross-border matters with specialist advisers, and ensure timely delivery in line with Mobility Policies and approval requirements.

Working closely with People, Payroll, Finance and external providers, you will identify risks early and lead improvements to mobility processes, systems and employee experience.

Responsibilities will include:

• Manage mobility cases end to end across global tax, social security, immigration and relocation, resolving complex issues.

• Oversee mobility compliance, documentation and data controls, including timely and accurate reporting of taxable vendor benefits.

• Advise stakeholders on mobility arrangements and policies, turning global specialist advice into action.

• Manage vendor performance, costs and escalations, including invoice review and internal cost recovery.

• Support stakeholder reporting on mobility progress, costs, risks and recommendations.

• Support mobility process improvements, including workflow optimization, integration and data management, and contribute to policy updates and implementation.

**You

**You have a relevant university degree and 5+ years of experience in global mobility within an international business or professional services firm.

You have experience managing cross-border mobility cases, coordinating tax, social security and immigration, and leading operational workstreams.

You are comfortable advising business stakeholders, managing external providers and exercising sound judgment on when to resolve matters independently and when to seek specialist input or escalate.

You also have a genuine interest in using AI and technology to improve service delivery and ways of working.

We look for the following in a candidate:

• Solid business acumen and ability to translate specialist advice into practical recommendations.

• Proven ability to own multiple cases and projects, coordinate contributors and resolve issues to deliver agreed outcomes.

• Sound judgment and initiative, with a structured, detail-oriented approach to prioritizing, anticipating dependencies and adapting to changing business needs.

• Experience optimizing mobility processes and implementing them within a mobility system is considered an advantage, but not a requirement.

• Fluency in English, both spoken and written.

The process

Please apply online as soon as possible as applications will be processed on an ongoing basis. For questions related to the role, please reach out to our Talent Acquisition team at recruitment@cipfs.com. We do not include CV's and Cover Letters sent by email.

As we continue to improve our candidate experience, diversity and avoid unconscious bias, please avoid having a photo in your CV. We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality for all applicants.

Please be aware that we will not accept speculative CV submissions for any of our roles from recruitment agencies, and any unsolicited candidate submissions will be exempt from any payment expectations and ownership.

---

CIP Fund Solutions’ commitment to diversity and inclusion

CIP Fund Solutions is committed to securing a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone feels respected and heard.

A diverse workforce allows CIP Fund Solutions to achieve results through different approaches and solutions to task execution and problem solving. We want all our employees to have equal opportunities for personal growth and career opportunities regardless of age, gender, sexual orientation, disability, religion, nationality, or ethnicity.

CIP Fund Solutions

CIP FS’ purpose is to enable CIP’s ambition to scale rapidly over the coming strategy-period - supporting our colleagues with professional and efficient financial, legal, tax and business operations through the cycle from fund formation and capital raising, to deploying investments into construction of large-scale greenfield renewable energy assets, as well as M&A.

For more information, please visit CIP Fund Solutions.

HR Manager

Take responsibility for HR operations, employee development and people management in an international project organisation.

Copenhagen Group A/S is a Danish project-driven company with a strong international profile.

We tender for and manage complex projects for international organisations and national authorities and, as the parent company of several specialised subsidiaries, provide the shared structure that ensures consistency across the Group.

Our activities span different markets, projects and stakeholders, placing high demands on structured HR processes and effective people management.

To support this, we are looking for an experienced and proactive HR Manager to take overall responsibility for HR activities and contribute to the continued development of the organisation.

Your Responsibilities

You will be responsible for managing and developing HR activities across Copenhagen Group, ensuring consistent and effective processes that support employees and management.

Your responsibilities will include personnel administration and the development and maintenance of HR policies, procedures and systems.

You will work closely with management on employee relations, organisational development, employee engagement, training and professional development

You will also ensure compliance with relevant employment legislation, maintain accurate employee records and provide management with HR data and guidance to support informed decision-making.

The role requires you to work independently, take ownership of HR processes and initiatives, and promote a positive working environment across the Group.

Your Background

We are looking for someone with proven experience in HR management or a similar role, including responsibility for HR processes, employee relations and personnel administration.

You have solid knowledge of Danish employment legislation and HR best practices, along with practical experience in recruitment, HR systems and employee development.

You are structured, reliable and proactive, with strong organisational skills, attention to detail and the ability to balance strategic initiatives with day-to-day responsibilities.

You have excellent interpersonal skills, exercise sound judgement and handle confidential matters with professionalism and discretion.

You communicate fluently in Danish and English, both verbally and in writing.

A relevant educational background in HR, business administration or a related field is required.

Practical Information

The position is based at our office in Copenhagen.

We offer a key position with a high degree of independence and responsibility, where you will have significant influence on HR practices and organisational development across Copenhagen Group.

Salary will reflect qualifications and experience.

Employment is conditional upon obtaining the required security clearance.

Are you ready to combine hands-on IT support with technical development in an international shipping company?

At Clipper Bulk, we are looking for an IT Operations & Support Specialist to join our IT team at our headquarters in Copenhagen.

This is an opportunity to become a key part of our IT function, ensuring reliable day-to-day support while gradually taking on broader responsibilities within IT operations, Microsoft 365 and infrastructure.

As IT Operations & Support Specialist, you will play an important role in keeping our IT environment running smoothly and supporting colleagues across the organisation. You will take ownership of daily IT support in close collaboration with the rest of the IT team, while also contributing to the maintenance, improvement and development of our IT systems.

Over time, you will have the opportunity to take on greater responsibility for operational tasks and smaller IT projects.

What will be your responsibilities:

Your responsibilities will include, but are not limited to:

• Providing hands-on IT support and troubleshooting for colleagues

• Managing and maintaining Microsoft 365 services, including Entra ID, Exchange Online and Intune

• Supporting device management, user administration and employee onboarding and offboarding

• Handling day-to-day IT operational tasks and ensuring system stability

• Supporting identity and access management, endpoint security and IT infrastructure

• Maintaining IT documentation, procedures and best practices

• Identifying opportunities to improve and automate IT processes

• Participating in smaller IT operations and infrastructure projects

• Collaborating with internal stakeholders and external IT service providers

What we are looking for:

At Clipper, our employees shape our work environment, so bringing a positive attitude is essential.

We are looking for someone who genuinely enjoys both IT support and technical operations. You are comfortable taking responsibility for day-to-day support, but you are also curious about the technology behind the systems and motivated to expand your technical capabilities. You don't just wait for the next support ticket. You take initiative, identify opportunities for improvement and follow tasks through to completion.

We imagine that you bring:

• Practical experience with IT support and technical troubleshooting

• Experience with Microsoft 365 administration, including Entra ID and related services

• Knowledge of Microsoft Intune, endpoint management and Windows client administration

• A good understanding of user management, access rights and IT security principles

• A structured and independent approach to solving technical challenges

• Good communication skills and a service-minded attitude

• Strong English communication skills, both written and spoken

• Experience with IT security and endpoint security solutions, network infrastructure, PowerShell, IT automation, identity and access management, IT projects or AI tools such as Microsoft Copilot would be an advantage, but is not a requirement

• Minimum 5 years of relevant experience

If you’re enthusiastic about this role but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with each qualification, we still encourage you to apply. You could be the ideal candidate for this position, or for another opportunity with us.

What you will love about us

At Clipper, you will become part of a growing and professional work environment where we strive to be the best. We offer:

• A varied role combining hands-on support, IT operations and technical development.

• The opportunity to gradually expand your responsibilities and technical expertise.

• Close collaboration with experienced IT colleagues.

• An international working environment with colleagues across our global offices.

• A welcoming and inclusive work environment with a variety of socal, sports, and cultural events throughout the year

• Attractive employee benefits, including pension, health, dental and critical ilness insurance

• Beautiful office facilities in Nordhavn, located near the metro with on-site parking, delicious lunch arangement and access to fitness facilities and a personal trainer.

Application and recruitment process:

Please submit your CV and cover letter through our application portal by 29th November 2026.

Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis and interviews will be treated with full discretion.

The recruitment process consists of two interview rounds. Shortlisted candidates will be invited to a first interview conducted via video call. Candidates progressing to the second round will be invited to an in-person interview and asked to complete a personality assessment and a logical reasoning test beforehand. Confidential reference checks will be conducted for final candidates.

Learn more about Clipper at clipper-bulk.com, LinkedIn, and Instagram.

Clipper is an industry leader in dry bulk, an operator, a pool manager, and a specialist in steel services. We operate a modern fleet of approximately 120 handysize and supramax vessels, transporting a wide range of cargo from dry bulk to break bulk. Clipper is commercially headquartered in Copenhagen and employs a staff of around 100 onshore worldwide__. We are a global workplace built on five shared values: Dependable, Curious, Collaboration, Hands-on and Family. We believe in learning from one another and welcome people with a growth mindset and ambition.

Sustainability initiatives - we strive to make a positive impact. As a maritime player with a global presence at sea and onshore, we recognize our social, environmental, and ethical responsibility. We push for positive development by responsibly running our business and promoting sustainable business behavior in our network. Read more about sustainability initiatives on our website.

Are you ready to take the next step in your M&A career and play a key role in shaping the growth of an international company with ambitious plans?

We are looking for an M&A Senior Manager, Corporate Development, to join KK Group and help drive our M&A strategy and broaden strategic growth agenda. This is an opportunity to work hands-on across the full deal lifecycle, from identifying and evaluating acquisition opportunities to transaction execution and post-acquisition integration.

You will take ownership of key transaction workstreams, work closely with senior stakeholders across the organization, and bring together financial analysis, commercial thinking and strategic insight to support important investment decisions.

The role offers significant responsibility, broad exposure to M&A and close collaboration with senior management, within an international group backed by A.P. Møller Holding, where M&A is an important lever for future growth.

The position is based in Copenhagen and requires presence in our Copenhagen office three days per week.

Your role

As an M&A Senior Manager in Corporate Development, your primary responsibility will be to support the development and execution of KK's M&A strategy, taking ownership of key analyses and transaction workstreams.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Perform and review financial analysis, financial modelling and company valuations to support M&A and other strategic investment decisions.

• Take responsibility for key workstreams in M&A transactions, including due diligence, coordination of external advisors, transaction documentation and other deal-related activities.

• Identify, screen and assess potential acquisition targets, including strategic fit, financial performance, valuation and key investment considerations.

• Develop investment cases, including strategic rationale, financial returns, risks and value creation opportunities, and contribute to the preparation of investment recommendations.

• Conduct market and competitor analysis to identify and assess potential acquisition targets, new markets and growth opportunities.

• Work closely with business divisions and relevant functions to assess commercial, financial and operational aspects of potential acquisitions.

• Support transaction structuring, negotiations and other activities throughout the transaction process.

• Work with business divisions and integration teams to identify and assess potential synergies and support post-acquisition integration planning.

• Contribute to broader corporate development and strategic initiatives across the Group.

Your profile

We expect you to have 4-6 years of relevant professional experience, preferably from investment banking, corporate M&A, private equity or Big 4 transaction services. Candidates with a background in strategy consulting and strong financial and transaction-related capabilities will also be considered.

In addition, we expect that you have:

• Strong financial and analytical capabilities, including extensive experience with financial modelling, valuation and financial statement analysis.

• Solid experience with M&A transactions, financial due diligence or other transaction-related activities, including responsibility for managing individual workstreams.

• Strong commercial understanding and the ability to combine financial analysis with strategic considerations and investment judgement.

• Advanced proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint, including the ability to develop clear and well-structured investment cases and decision material.

• Strong project management skills, with the ability to coordinate multiple workstreams and deliver high-quality work within tight deadlines.

• The ability to work independently, take ownership of complex tasks and challenge assumptions when relevant.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate financial and strategic conclusions to senior stakeholders.

• A collaborative mindset and the ability to work effectively with stakeholders across functions, countries and organisational levels.

• Fluency in written and spoken English.

We value intellectual curiosity, sound judgement and a strong sense of ownership. You should be comfortable working in an environment where priorities can change, and where you are expected to take initiative, challenge assumptions and drive your own workstreams forward.

Ready to take ownership of key M&A workstreams and help shape KK Group’s next phase of growth? We would love to hear from you.

jobs.occupation: Analyst in Capital Planning – Help Shape the Bank’s Financial Future
jobs.description:
Capital planning sits at the heart of how Danske Bank balances financial resilience with sustainable growth. As part of a close-knit analytical team, you will contribute to decisions that enable the bank to serve its customers and support its strategic ambitions. This is a role where your work genuinely matters and where you will build a solid foundation in capital management.

What you will be doing

The Capital Planning team is part of Financial Resource Management in Group Treasury, sitting within Danske Bank's CFO area. The team of seven works on capital target setting, capital issuances, dividend decisions and macroeconomic stress testing. Your analyses and reports will receive close attention from the Executive Leadership Team, the Board of Directors and financial regulators. The atmosphere is collaborative, with knowledge sharing and learning woven into everyday working life, and the team takes pride in delivering high-quality work while enjoying the process.

More specifically, you will:

• Support monthly capital and MREL assessments and projections

• Analyse the effects of regulatory and model changes with relevant teams

• Contribute to stress tests and assessments of capital targets and buffers

• Help analyse payout capacity and capital and MREL funding needs

• Prepare decision material and gradually take ownership of defined deliverables

About you

• Master's degree in economics, finance, business administration or a related field

• Strong analytical skills and a structured, detail-oriented approach

• Ability to communicate complex findings clearly in English

• Curious and collaborative, with an interest in learning and developing within the field

• Comfortable working independently on defined tasks while contributing to team goals

Experience in banking or capital management, and familiarity with Python, SQL or similar tools, would be a welcome addition. We consider candidates at different stages of their career, so we encourage you to apply whether you are just starting out or bring a few years of relevant experience.

What we offer you

You will join a dedicated team where collaboration and continuous learning are part of daily work. We work in a hybrid model, with three to four days per week in the office to support knowledge sharing and team cohesion. You will have room to develop your analytical skills, deepen your understanding of capital management, and take on increasing responsibility over time.

Are you ready for the next step?

If this sounds like the right opportunity for you, we would be glad to hear from you. Feel free to reach out to hiring manager Henrik Bang at hban@danskebank.dk if you have any questions about the role before applying.

We review applications on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible or by 22 November 2026 at the latest.

We look forward to hearing from you!

About the Team

At the Enterprise Process Management (EPM) unit, our north star is “Partnering towards process excellence.” As Danske Bank’s internal consultancy, the Process Intelligence team collaborates across the organization to drive impactful process improvements and embed operational excellence, deliivering real value. We work side-by-side with business units and agile tribes, supporting strategic growth initiatives and fostering a culture of continuous improvement.

Our Process Partners play a key role in driving transformations for efficiency and building capabilities in process management. By leveraging Lean methodologies and best practices, we help optimize processes, reduce waste, enhance customer satisfaction and regulatory compliance, and strengthen the organization’s ability to deliver sustainable results. We coach leaders to translate operational excellence principles into lasting behavioural change

What You Will Do

• Drive end-to-end process optimization initiatives, applying Lean principles and eliminating waste.

• Lead and participate in projects focused on customer journeys, process transformation, and change management, using methods such as DMAIC.

• Identify and prioritize organizational benefits, aligning process improvements with business goals and customer needs.

• Acquire and analyze data to uncover improvement opportunities, utilizing Lean and Six Sigma tools and statistical concepts.

• Develop and operationalize process improvement frameworks, ensuring the sustainability and control of implemented solutions.

• Deliver training and mentor colleagues on Lean and process improvement methods, fostering leadership development (both self and others) and a culture of continuous improvement.

Operational information is the backbone of how a bank operates, and getting it right matters.

We are looking for an experienced and strategic leader to strengthen the Group-wide operational information blueprint, with accountability anchored in the Operational Design & Governance team within Enterprise Process Management.

In this role, you will lead a critical Group-wide capability, strengthening how we design, structure and govern operational information across the Group. You will strengthen the foundations for simpler and more transparent operations, effective transformation, regulatory readiness, automation and AI adoption.

Your role

Your mission is to mature and strengthen the Group-wide operational information model, making it increasingly coherent, consistent, scalable and fit for both commercial and regulatory needs, while driving its adoption across the organisation.

You will lead a team of 16 specialists within Enterprise Process Management and own the direction and evolution of the Group’s operational information capability. Working across organisational boundaries, you will collaborate closely with Business Units, Enterprise Architecture, Risk, Compliance, Technology and Transformation teams.

More specifically, you will:

• 
Lead and develop a high-performing team of specialists while building a collaborative and outcome-focused culture.

• 
Set clear direction for the Group operational information model design and establish clear methodologies, standards and governance across the Group.

• 
Strengthen operational governance and accountability across functions, value chains, business services, processes, manual services, SOPs and business procedures.

• 
Drive adoption and execution, ensuring frameworks and standards translate into practical and scalable solutions across the Bank.

• 
Create foundations for AI, automation and data-driven operations through high-quality operational information and strong design principles.

• 
Partner across the Bank, connecting business, operations, architecture, technology, data, risk, controls and transformation perspectives.

• 
Advise and guide senior stakeholders on operational information design, governance and operating model decisions.

What we are looking for

You are an experienced and strategic leader who combines enterprise thinking with the ability to turn direction into execution.

You bring:

• 
Proven leadership experience from leading large specialist or transformation teams with a broad range of deliverables.

• 
Strong expertise in business architecture, process management and/or operating model design.

• 
Strong business acumen and the ability to connect strategic objectives with operational realities.

• 
A strategic mindset combined with strong execution capabilities and a track record of delivering measurable outcomes.

• 
Experience driving enterprise-wide change in a complex and regulated environment, preferably financial services.

• 
Strong ability to navigate complexity, influence senior stakeholders and drive alignment across organisational boundaries.

• 
Experience establishing and implementing methodologies, standards, frameworks and governance models.

• 
A strong understanding of how business, operations, technology, data, risk and controls connect across the enterprise.

• 
An interest in how operational information design and governance can create the foundations for AI, automation and analytics.

• 
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, combined with a passion for developing people and teams.

What success looks like

You will help create an operating environment where operational information is well-designed, governed and trusted; complexity is reduced; accountability is clear; and the Bank is better equipped to execute transformation and adopt new technologies at scale.

Success will ultimately mean making it easier for the organisation to understand how we operate, how our operations connect, and where we need to change.

Why join us?

You will lead a critical EPM capability at the intersection of business design, governance, transformation, technology, data and AI. The role offers significant scope to influence how the Bank operates at scale and to help build a simpler, more coherent and future-ready organisation.

• Comfortable translating complex technical topics into practical business recommendations

• Curious, collaborative, and focused on continuous improvement

Working at Shell Low Carbon Solutions Biogas (formerly Nature Energy)

By joining Shell Biogas, you will be part of a highly experienced and ambitious team in the circular economy. Our common denominator is that we want to build a sustainable future for our planet and our people. From our main office in Odense, Denmark, Shell Biogas is the European market leader in the development, design, construction, and operation of large, industrialized biogas plants paving the way for a sustainable future by turning waste into value. The company owns and operates 14 biogas plants in Europe and is launching new biogas projects in Europe. Shell Biogas currently employs about 500 dedicated employees across offices in Europe and US. Shell Low Carbon Solutions is responsible for laying the solid foundations for Shell's future beyond its traditional businesses and, critically, Shell’s capability to increasingly offer low-carbon solutions to help our customers decarbonise their activities.

For more information please visit our website www.shell.dk

Please note: We occasionally amend or withdraw Shell jobs and reserve the right to do so at any time, including prior to the advertised closing date. Before applying, you are advised to read our data protection policy. This policy describes the processing that may be associated with your personal data and informs you that your personal data may be transferred to Shell/Shell Group companies around the world. The Shell Group and its approved recruitment consultants will never ask you for a fee to process or consider your application for a career with Shell. Anyone who demands such a fee is not an authorised Shell representative and you are strongly advised to refuse any such demand. Shell is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Celare Quantum Communications is a Danish high-tech quantum technology company with a mission to radically improve cybersecurity and enable trusted global data sharing.

Our core product is Continuous-Variable Quantum Key Distribution (CV-QKD), a unique, cutting-edge technology born from years of university research. This technology enables quantum-secure key exchange for protecting sensitive data across critical infrastructure.

Celare partners with national and international governments, telecom operators, data centers, banks, defense ministries, and leading academic institutions. Over the past year, our team has launched commercial pilot deployments of our technology.

The Celare Team

We are a highly specialized and ambitious team of quantum engineers, serial entrepreneurs, mathematicians, software engineers, IC and FPGA designers, and specialists in lasers, RF, and electronics.

Based in Copenhagen, we combine deep academic expertise with practical experience in launching complex, high-impact technology products.

The Role

In this role, you will get a unique opportunity to work at the cutting edge of quantum technology development. You will join our FPGA/ASIC team and work directly with FPGA design for high-speed data processing, testbench development, and the early stages of our ASIC development.

As part of a small and agile organization, you will contribute across the full product lifecycle — from early architectural decisions and prototyping to production and large-scale deployment. You will work both in collaboration with our team and independently as a specialist, sharing knowledge across disciplines.

This is a hands-on role with real responsibility and influence. It offers the chance to work in a dynamic, international, multilingual, and multicultural team with direct connections to academic research and state-of-the-art technologies.

The role is based on-site at our Copenhagen headquarters.

Responsibilities

• Contributing to the early stages of ASIC design, from architecture to RTL

• Designing and implementing high-speed data processing systems on FPGAs

• Developing self-checking testbenches and verification environments for FPGA/ASIC designs

• Developing and integrating IP cores

• Participating in system-level integration

• Bringing up, testing, and debugging hardware in the lab

Qualifications

• MSc in electrical engineering or similar

• 5+ years of hands-on FPGA/ASIC design experience, including IP core integration, FPGA timing closure, and floorplanning

• Proficiency in Verilog/SystemVerilog (or VHDL)

• Experience with ASIC-grade verification, e.g., UVM, constrained-random and coverage-driven testing, SystemVerilog Assertions, and bit-accurate reference models

• Experience implementing high-speed data processing on complex FPGAs (e.g., AMD/Xilinx UltraScale+) and their toolchains

• Experience with high-speed interfaces such as PCIe, JESD204B/C, and multi-gigabit transceivers

• Proficiency in scripting, e.g., Tcl, Bash, and Python

• Good understanding of high-speed signal integrity

Nice to have

• Experience with ASIC design flows, e.g., synthesis, static timing analysis, DFT, and gate-level simulation

• Experience with high-speed board design (schematic design, PCB layout, integration, and power delivery)

We Offer

This full-time position offers the opportunity to build and shape the future of quantum communication in collaboration with an experienced and dynamic team. We provide individual growth plans aligned with your personal preferences and motivation. We offer competitive compensation commensurate with qualifications and experience.

Contact

For more information, or to apply, send an email to jobs@celare-quantum.com with the subject line “FPGA/ASIC Design Engineer”.

jobs.occupation: Laser Engineer – High-Power Spectral Beam Combining
jobs.description:
The Mission: Build the Next Generation of SBC Systems

Ibsen Photonics develops Spectral Beam Combining (SBC) modules for high-power laser architectures, based on our in-house transmission gratings. We are looking for a Laser Engineer to join the High-Power Beam Combining team and contribute across design, assembly, and experimental optimisation of these modules — working closely with colleagues and international partners.

What you will do

• Design and assemble compact SBC modules based on Ibsen's transmission gratings, accounting for optical beam paths, thermal effects, and mechanical constraints

• Optimise optical alignment, mechanical stability, and thermal management at high power loads in iterative design–experiment–optimise cycles

• Characterise beam quality during power scaling, including M², wavefront sensing, and spectral analysis

• Support sourcing of optical and mechanical components and the transition from experimental prototypes to scalable, volume-ready designs

• Collaborate with internal teams and international partners, including occasional overseas visits for joint prototyping and testing

What you bring

You are a proactive problem-solver who thrives in a "build-test-learn" environment.

Ideally, you possess

• MSc or PhD in optics, photonics, laser physics, or a related field

• Documented laboratory experience with high-power optics and/or lasers

• Knowledge of high-power-capable optical design practices, including thermal lensing, runaway effects, and their mitigation, as well as Gaussian optics and beam propagation

• Knowledge of opto-mechanical design practices for high-power devices

• Hands-on experience with precise free-space and/or fibre optical alignment and experimental troubleshooting

• Experience with beam quality measurement and analysis

• Professional proficiency in English

Nice to have

• Experience with SBC or CBC techniques

• Mechanical design of tight-tolerance devices and familiarity with mechanical CAD

• Experience transitioning prototypes toward volume production

• Proficiency in optical simulation tools (e.g. Zemax)

Security and export control: This position is subject to defence-related export control and security requirements. You must be able to obtain the required Danish security clearance.

Why join Ibsen Photonics?

• Visible Impact: Your will work directly on the core technology and design behind next generation of SBC modules, with real autonomy over how you solve the tasks you are given. Your results will carry through from lab prototypes to finished products supplied to international customers

• Working culture: A supportive, flat organisation with short decision paths, open knowledge sharing, and a healthy work-life balance.

Ready to make a difference?

Submit your CV and cover letter via the link. We recruit as soon as possible and keep the position open until filled.

Please write in your application that you've seen the job at Techjob.
